Tactics

Communication and conflict reduction

Practise calm, clear and tactically safe communication for pressured scenarios.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Read the scene first

Assess people, distance, exits, objects and the wider environment before approaching. Good positioning creates time and space for communication.

State purpose and expectation

Use short, understandable messages: who you are, what you observed, what the person needs to do and what happens next.

01ASSIGNMENT02AUTHORITY03PROPORTION04REPORT

Listen for change

Tone, body language and additional people can change the risk picture. Reassess continuously and request support early when control is decreasing.

Record observable facts

A report should separate what you saw and heard, what instructions were given and why each action was selected.
